title: The map says how the code fits together, in checked prose, in every repo
why: Your ask, Oct 27 15:28 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2TkTAVedLJHUNKVx7WVmM42): a map that you and the AI both read before answering "how does X work", which stops building a second copy where a shared thing exists, records facts like a retry wait or which avenues a pricing export covers, and checks that what we say in English is what the code does. You asked to be told plainly if this is the wrong avenue.
note: Today skills/plain-english-map (o6, moved here Oct 20) maps files, tables and screens only: no relationships, no pointer to the shared home a file should use, no key values, and its check proves an entry exists, not that its prose is still true. Triage's view: the avenue is right, on one condition; prose that nothing checks rots and then misleads the AI with confidence. So each claim ("retries every 30 s", "export covers A and B") cites the symbol or constant it describes, and a check reads that value and fails when the two disagree. banchi's docs/map.py and decision-context are the nearest working example. The shared-home half joins t18 (one home, then variants) and lint/find_copies.py (r5). Plan done Oct 28: plans/c146-checked-prose-map.md (Sonnet fact-check clear): MAP9 in skills/plain-english-map/scripts/map-check.mjs checks indented fact lines that cite a symbol's value, uses FILE:SYMBOL relations and a Homes section; format version 3; a mapPaths key; a pilot of about 6 files in claude-settings; a CI step. Rulings, Oct 28 02:40 CDT (shiv): pilot with a mapPaths key, about 6 files (item 22, b); read banchi's docs/map.py first (26, a); the word is "fact line" (28, a); fix map-skill-lives-here.md, no pinned copies (29, a). Deferred (shiv, Oct 28): read-map-first's home, exact numbers, format version 3, the home check. Asked: waiting page items 23, 24, 25 and 27. Port: yes, once perfected; q_max's drifted copy goes in r5. Placed ahead of r5 (triage, Oct 27): each repo's roll-out should carry the map that keeps it honest.
